    <p>{`Let's understand more about the design of each specific API.`}</p>
    <h3 {...{
      "id": "about-the-dub-api"
    }}>{`About the Dub API`}</h3>
    <p>{`The `}<strong parentName="p">{`Dub API`}</strong>{` is the more comprehensive service and can perform all three steps in the workflow. It consumes input media and can perform the transcription, translation to a target language, and dub, all at once. An optional AI lip sync is also available for the dubbed video.`}</p>
    <p>{`This API also accepts transcripts as input, from Adobe's Transcript API or elsewhere, and can perform a dub using that transcript. Use edited transcripts in this way for more precise control over the final dub.`}</p>
    <h3 {...{
      "id": "about-the-transcribe-api"
    }}>{`About the Transcribe API`}</h3>
    <p>{`The `}<strong parentName="p">{`Transcribe API`}</strong>{` converts speech from audio and video files into a text transcript which can be used as input for the Dub API. Transcribe content in the source language or translate it into target languages, and generate captions.`}</p>
    <p>{`This API can't re-translate a source transcript. A translation operation only occurs simultaneously with the transcription from the source media.`}</p>

    <h3 {...{
